after.name: Gradient Beacons

after.name: Detection Core
after.description:
An energy device created after using his Elemental Skill. Tapping it creates a Core in Steady State, while holding it creates an Overloaded core.

Detection Core: Steady State
·Continuously follows nearby opponents and intermittently deals AoE Electro DMG;
·When Mitya has reached the maximum number of Gradient Beacons he can have, the device will consume any newly generated Gradient Beacon and deal AoE Electro DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG;
·When its duration ends or another Detection Core is created, the device will consume all Gradient Beacons Mitya has and deal AoE Electro DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG based on the number consumed.

Detection Core: Overloaded
·While this device is present and Mitya has at least 1 Gradient Beacon, he can perform the special Charged Attack Gradient Detonation without consuming Stamina.

changes.before: Grants different enhancement effects based on the mode the Elemental Skill's {LINK#N11360002}<color=#FFD780FF>Energy Device</color>{/LINK} is in:\nStable Mode: For each Prism Mitya has, all nearby party members gain 30 Elemental Mastery;\nCollapse Mode: Upon triggering a Stellar-Conduct reaction, the effect changes to generating 1 {LINK#N11360001}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Prism</color>{/LINK} every 1.5s for 3s.
changes.after: The <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> created by the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> is enhanced. after.name: Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment
after.description: Valeriy's special Charged Attack. Using a Charged Attack while he has at least 40 Impact Momentum consumes all Impact Momentum to unleash this special Charged Attack instead, dealing AoE Electro DMG in front of him and granting 15 stacks of Offensive Directive.

after.name: Offensive Directive
after.description:
A special effect Valeriy gains after performing the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment. It increases different types of Electro DMG depending on whether Valeriy is in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state. If Valeriy is:
·In the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state: When a nearby active character in the party deals Electro DMG considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG to an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of Offensive Directive is consumed to increase that DMG, with the increase based on Valeriy's ATK;
·Not in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state: When a nearby active character in the party deals Electro DMG to an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst, 1 stack of Offensive Directive is consumed to increase that DMG, with the increase based on Valeriy's ATK.
When a single instance of Electro DMG hits multiple opponents simultaneously, Offensive Directive stacks are consumed based on the number of opponents hit.

after.name: Impact Momentum
after.description:
A special energy Valeriy uses to enhance his combat capabilities. Its initial maximum is 100. When he has at least 40 Impact Momentum, he can perform the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment.
Valeriy can gain Impact Momentum in the following ways:
·By using his Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge;
·After unlocking the Passive Talent "Advance With the Creeping Barrage," while his Elemental Burst Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo is active, when a nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an attack whose Elemental Type is Electro.

changes.before: While the <color=#FFD780FF>Stormshells</color> from his Elemental Burst are falling, Valeriy gains 5 <color=#FFD780FF>Charge</color> whenever the active character deals Electro DMG to an opponent. A maximum of 80 Charge can be restored to Valeriy in this way over the duration of each Elemental Burst.
changes.after: Valeriy gains 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> whenever a nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an attack whose Elemental Type is <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> while the <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are falling. He can gain up to 80 <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.
